x_snc_devtools_technical_debt.description: The OOTB REST API end point for Plugin activation does not support a parameter to require a specific version of a Plugin - which makes it impossible to install Plugins strictly according to requirements. A solution must be found to ensure that the target instance is updated to exactly the requested state.
x_snc_devtools_technical_debt.short_description: TargetInstancePluginActivate() does not support required version
x_snc_devtools_technical_debt.sys_name: TargetInstancePluginActivate() does not support required version
